createOrReplace.title: Application process - Psychology - University of Amsterdam
createOrReplace.excerpt: You can submit your enrolment application for the academic year 2027-2028 in Studielink from 1 October 2026 till 15 January 2027. We will have 270 places available for the English track in the academic year 2027-2028. Students with a foreign diploma are eligible to apply if their diploma is equivalent to the Dutch pre-university diploma (vwo-diploma) and includes: Mathematics English as part of your final examinations. The level of mathematics should be equivalent to at least the Dutch level of VWO mathematics: Wiskunde A. Applicants are therefore required to submit proof of sufficient proficiency in English (Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR): level C1). By completing fully English-taught secondary education in Australia, Canada (with the exception of Quebec), Ireland, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States of America; By obtaining an International Baccalaureate DP diploma with English as an IB exam subject IELTS Academic 6.5 Each subscore: 6 TOEFL (iBT) Scoring scale: 0-120* 92 Each subscore: 22 Cambridge C1 Advanced 175 Cambridge C2 Proficiency 180 *Scoring scale until 20 January 2026 To be eligible for admission to the programme, you must participate in the selection process.
